scenario: `i`, `j`, `e`, `E` are reserved language builtins (e/E for sci-notation in FLOAT_LIT; i/j held for the `complex` type, which is specified and not v1 per [LUNI.14]) and cannot be unit names. SITE: this pins the LEXER, not resolution. Bare `i`/`j` is withheld from `UNIT_SUFFIX` outright ([LLEX.11.3.1]), so `5_i` does not lex as `UNIT_LIT(5, suffix=i)` at all, and with COMPLEX_LIT absent from v1 it reaches no token class — `cooldown 5_i` surfaces DS_PARSE_GENERIC from the parser. Note the code here is reachable only from this phase: DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_UNIT is emitted from one site, general expression position, and a duration position like `cooldown` never consults the unit registry at all — see LUNI.3.1_unknown_unit_in_expr for that site.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope ttl 30s:
    v: Int

rule trig cooldown 5_i:
    Sensor s where s.v > 0
->
    log info "reserved letter"
